name: SFCC Tools
description: Salesforce Commerce Cloud work in Orca: ISML, cartridge upload, sandbox status and the new errors of its log, over the official b2c CLI.

cover.alt: The plugin name beside a panel with the sandbox status, the upload of each cartridge, the new errors of the log and a line of ISML

settings.title: b2c path
settings.description: The b2c CLI to run: a name found on PATH, or the full path to it.

settings.title: Configuration file
settings.description: A dw.json to read instead of the workspace's own. Empty: dw.json at the root of the workspace, or of the project's main checkout when a worktree has none. A relative path starts at the workspace.

settings.title: Development key suffix
settings.description: Appended to each key of dw.json (hostname, client-id, ...) to find the development instance.

settings.title: Staging key suffix
settings.description: Appended to each key of dw.json (hostname, client-id, ...) to find the staging instance.

settings.title: Production key suffix
settings.description: Appended to each key of dw.json (hostname, client-id, ...) to find the production instance.

settings.title: Code version prefix
settings.description: Put before the workspace name to make the code version each workspace uploads to (ws-checkout-fix). Letters, digits, - and _. A workspace keeps the name it got first.
